Reverse Engineer Anything (REA), an open-source project with 200K+ GitHub stars, connects coding agents like Claude Code and Codex to tools like Ghidra, Hopper, and IDA.

The project lets developers inspect compiled binaries, trace function calls, and investigate how applications implement specific features.

👉 Learn more: https://www.infoq.com/news/2026/10/reverse-engineer-anything/
